# Essential Oils & Specialty Ingredients

Since our inception in 2010, Bulk Apothecary has quickly expanded to become the nation’s leading
supplier of soap making supplies and specialty ingredients. Our meteoric rise is directly related to
our strong focus on superior quality and excellent customer service. This commitment has allowed
us to build relationships with millions of customers that trust us as their source for premium
fragrance oils, certified organic essential oils, and other soap supplies.  In addition to a
complete line of specialty ingredients, we have also expanded our offering with a complete line of
ready to private label products including bath bombs, cold process soaps, candles, and personal care
products.  Lastly, we have leveraged our economies of scale to introduce wholesale products and
fragrances from some of the world's best-known brands.

# Soap Making Supplies from The Nation's Largest Online Supplier of Fragrance Oil, Soap Bases,
# Essential Oils & Specialty Ingredients

Since our inception in 2010, Bulk Apothecary has quickly expanded to become the nation’s leading
supplier of soap making supplies and specialty ingredients. Our meteoric rise is directly related to
our strong focus on superior quality and excellent customer service. This commitment has allowed
us to build relationships with millions of customers that trust us as their source for premium
fragrance oils, certified organic essential oils, and other soap supplies.  In addition to a
complete line of specialty ingredients, we have also expanded our offering with a complete line of
ready to private label products including bath bombs, cold process soaps, candles, and personal care
products.  Lastly, we have leveraged our economies of scale to introduce wholesale products and
fragrances from some of the world's best-known brands.

## Des produits 100% biologiques et naturels

Chez Florihana nous créons des solutions qui répondent naturellement aux besoins de tout un chacun
en intégrant la nature et la préservation de l’environnement au cœur même de la Distillerie.

Nous répondons aux exigences les plus strictes en matière de produits biologiques. Nos huiles
essentielles, huiles végétales, eaux florales, huiles de macération sont régulièrement contrôlés et
répondent à de nombreux labels.

set by us or by third party providers. If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these

## ABOUT AETHON INTERNATIONAL LLP

# **Aethon International LLP is amongst the largest Essential Oil Manufacturers, Exporters &
# Suppliers in India.**

**Aethon International LLP** is amongst the leading **Essential Oil Manufacturers in
India**. Essential oils are concentrated plant extracts that can be used for a wide variety of
purposes, including aromatherapy, massage, and skincare. Our Company has a history of producing
high-quality products that meet customer expectations. The Company has a strong African connection
for procurement and sale of natural cosmetic raw materials in bulk for industrial use in
the Cosmetics and Health Care / Skincare Sector. Our quality is well respected and trusted.** **We
are a group of highly motivated, well-educated and experienced individuals with an aim to provide
quality products transcending geographical barriers along with a constant endeavor to rationalize
the costs to the consumer.

**  Our motto rests on three pillars:-**
* Process, import and export natural cosmetic ingredients like oils, butters, fats etc for usage in
  cosmetics through efficient supply chain and minimising role of middle-men
* Bring the best quality natural products from Farm to Skin with minimal human intervention
* Promote Indian products like Amla, Brahmi, Ashwagandha and many more in national and international
  cosmetic market.

Being a top Carrier Oils Exporters and Suppliers in India, Our head office is centrally located in
Noida (India) with procurement services in Nigeria. Our associate company in West Africa, Aethon
Africa Ventures Limited, is engaged in sourcing shea nuts, procesisng and packaging shea butter,
along with trade in other commodities. We process pure, organic unrefined shea butter of high
quality in Africa.

## ABOUT AETHON INTERNATIONAL LLP

# **Aethon International LLP is amongst the largest Essential Oil Manufacturers, Exporters &
# Suppliers in India.**

**Aethon International LLP** is amongst the leading **Essential Oil Manufacturers in
India**. Essential oils are concentrated plant extracts that can be used for a wide variety of
purposes, including aromatherapy, massage, and skincare. Our Company has a history of producing
high-quality products that meet customer expectations. The Company has a strong African connection
for procurement and sale of natural cosmetic raw materials in bulk for industrial use in
the Cosmetics and Health Care / Skincare Sector. Our quality is well respected and trusted.** **We
are a group of highly motivated, well-educated and experienced individuals with an aim to provide
quality products transcending geographical barriers along with a constant endeavor to rationalize
the costs to the consumer.

**  Our motto rests on three pillars:-**
* Process, import and export natural cosmetic ingredients like oils, butters, fats etc for usage in
  cosmetics through efficient supply chain and minimising role of middle-men
* Bring the best quality natural products from Farm to Skin with minimal human intervention
* Promote Indian products like Amla, Brahmi, Ashwagandha and many more in national and international
  cosmetic market.

Being a top Carrier Oils Exporters and Suppliers in India, Our head office is centrally located in
Noida (India) with procurement services in Nigeria. Our associate company in West Africa, Aethon
Africa Ventures Limited, is engaged in sourcing shea nuts, procesisng and packaging shea butter,
along with trade in other commodities. We process pure, organic unrefined shea butter of high
quality in Africa.

Our 50,000 sq. ft. GMP-certified facility is engineered for high-volume cosmetic and essential oil

* Automated filling and packaging lines (creams, serums, oils, liquids)
* Steam distillation units for essential oil extraction
* Cold-chain storage for temperature-sensitive raw materials
* In-house stability testing chambers (ICH compliant)
* Warehousing capacity for 10,000+ pallet positions
* Dedicated export documentation and logistics team

10 ml roller bottle · 2% dilution · ready in five minutes
* Lavender *(Lavandula angustifolia)* 2 drops
* Sweet Orange *(Citrus sinensis)* 2 drops
* Jojoba carrier fill to 10 ml

**Make it:** add the drops, fill with jojoba, cap and roll between your palms. **Use it:** wrists
and back of the neck, twenty minutes before winding down. Patch-test first. You'll learn why in

Every oil we teach with is GC/MS-tested. You'll learn to read the report
Plant-based medicine, shown not told

notes. Touch an ingredient on the card to see its note. This is Pathway 1's teaching style from the
first lesson.

"Lavender does the calming, and it's the linalool doing the work."

studied for relaxation. You'll meet both in the chemistry unit.

"Sweet orange keeps it bright, and it's one citrus that plays nice with skin in the sun."

The science: expressed sweet orange is regarded as non-phototoxic, which is exactly the kind of
safety distinction this course trains you to make between look-alike oils.

2%

# EXCELLENCE WITH TRADITIONS

Bulk essential oil supplier

Order samples

## A heritage that goes back three generations

Atmosphaer is an essential oil supplier and a reliable partner to your business. We supply
high-quality Bulgarian essential oils in bulk for the perfume and cosmetic industry. You can order
in large quantities and expect the best quality with every delivery. The company has significant
experience in the field that allows for precision, quality control and impeccable expertise.
Atmosphaer’ success in the industry is based on the above-mentioned experience that we’ve gathered
throughout the years. We take pride in what we do and we’ve prioritised the quality of both our
products and our customer’s current needs and requirements. To put it simply – we care. 

## Bulk essential oils

We offer essential oils in bulk.

Atmosphaer’s products have been chosen by some of the most renowned cosmetic, perfume and food
manufacturers from France, Italy, the US and the rest of the world. Both clients and IFEAT delegates
are welcome to visit Atmosphaer’s production plant and experience the magic of the production
process in person. We will be happy to have you here to show you our diligence and inspiration that
underlie each step of the way.

[ORDER SAMPLES][13]
* Lavender
* Bulgarian rose
* Melissa
* Yarrow
* Juniper berry
* Basil
* [Chamomile][Chamomile]
  Chamomile
* Geranium
[Lavender essential oil][Lavender essential oil]

## Organic essential oil supplier

We also supply organic oils of the finest quality. They are 100% pure organic material, perfect for
the production of organic cosmetics, perfumes and food. We are a certified supplier, so you can be
certain of the quality of the products. Atmosphaer observes the best practices in the production,
packaging and delivery processes to ensure compliance with the highest standards industry-wise.
Depending on the mateirial type, we use special containers for storing and transporting the material
that preserve its characteristics and ensure safe transportation.

## Buy in bulk for your business

At Atmosphaer, we believe in total transparency and this is why we guarantee the full traceability
of our products from soil to sample. Strategically located within the beautiful Rose Valley of
Bulgaria it benefits from a vast selection of rose and lavender gardens offering a lush and fresh
supply of herb and flower blossoms. Combining the best manufacturing practices and the highest
quality standards, the distillery has been producing the finest Damascena Rose oil for over 25 years
now. We are happy to be able to supply the bulk material for your business, offer competitive and
fair prices as well.

[Get in Touch][14]

## Absolute dedication to quality

Atmosphaer holds Good Manufacturing Practice certification that asserts our conscientious approach
to hygiene, sanitary and processing practices in our daily work. We meet and exceed all of the
criteria for the GMP certification because we take the safety and hygiene standards in our industry
very seriously. We are proud to say we are also REACH-compliant. We have a registration number for
the production and processing of registered substances, which we supply to our customers, so they
can also show that they comply with European regulations.

## Ethically sourced materials

We, at Atmosphaer, have made sure that the materials that we use for our products are ethically
sourced, meaning that we don’t work with vendors that implement child labour into their practices
and bad work conditions for their farmers.

We also support fair trade and aim to support small businesses – all of the supply companies that
we’ve partnered up with are given a fair price for their produce.

We believe that all of these important measures can make a huge, positive impact on the whole
industry and help the tradition live on.

### A global leader in the essential oils and aromatic chemicals industry

Berjé’s commitment to stability and consistency in flavor and fragrance ingredients has fostered
long-term partnerships in over 100 sourcing locations. Combined with our supply chain expertise,
this ensures unmatched reliability in a constantly evolving market.

[ About Berjé ][22]

## Our products

Essential Oils

#### Essential Oils & Derivatives

[Essential Oils & Derivatives]

Essential oils are the concentrated aroma and flavor profiles extracted from the flowers, fruits,
roots, bark, leaves, and herbs of botanicals from around the world.

[image-e1761896364523.jpg]

Organics

#### Organic Oils

For more than 20 years, Berjé has partnered with Oregon Tilth to certify our growing list of organic
products. Organic essential oils have become an increasingly important commodity within the modern
flavor and fragrance industry.

[ladies-e1761900686117.jpg]

Fixed Oils

#### Fixed Oils

In the essential oils industry, “fixed oils” are non-volatile oils from botanical sources. Also
called “carrier” or “base” oils, they evaporate more slowly than essential oils and have a longer
shelf life.

Upcycled Ingredients

#### Upcycled Ingredients

Berjé’s Upcycled Ingredients highlight the beauty of resource diversity and innovation at source,
embracing the sustainable, regenerative nature of our global botanicals.

Naturals

#### Natural Aromatics

Berjé offers a full range of natural aromatics and isolates – expertly sourced compounds derived
from natural materials such as plants, fruits, flowers, spices, and resins.

[farm-e1761900668825.jpg]

Aromatic Chemicals

#### Aromatic Chemicals

Flavors and fragrances stem from the art of chemistry. To complement our essential oils, Berjé
offers over 2,500 natural and synthetic aromatic chemicals.

## The [berje logo] promise

We’re committed to being your trusted partner and reliable innovator, providing quality ingredients
with a focus on safety and compliance. Our service and products reflect our values of integrity,
accountability, leadership, legacy, diversity, and passion every day.

### 235,000

###### Sqft. Inventory

Our Carteret, NJ headquarters houses the most diverse essential oils and aromatic chemicals
inventory in the U.S., just 15 minutes from key ports.

### 55,000

###### Drums on Site

We maintain in stock over 5.5 million kilograms of inventory, ensuring quality and traceability for
every container through strict internal QC standards.

### 2,500

###### Aromatic Chemicals

Complementing our natural oils, Berjé stocks over 2,500 aromatic chemicals, both natural and

### 300

###### Essential Oils

Berjé offers over 300 essential oils from global partners, ranging from artisan oils like Bulgarian

#### Essential Oils & Derivatives

[Essential Oils & Derivatives]

Essential oils are the concentrated aroma and flavor profiles extracted from the flowers, fruits,
roots, bark, leaves, and herbs of botanicals from around the world.

[image-e1761896364523.jpg]

Organics

#### Organic Oils

For more than 20 years, Berjé has partnered with Oregon Tilth to certify our growing list of organic
products. Organic essential oils have become an increasingly important commodity within the modern
flavor and fragrance industry.

[ladies-e1761900686117.jpg]

Fixed Oils

#### Fixed Oils

In the essential oils industry, “fixed oils” are non-volatile oils from botanical sources. Also
called “carrier” or “base” oils, they evaporate more slowly than essential oils and have a longer
shelf life.

# Manufacturer of World Class 100% Pure & Natural Essential Oils, Resins, Perfume Oils and Fragrance
# Oils

Since our inception in the year 1990, the primary objective of BMV has been to passionately work
towards the creation of a nature friendly environment. BMV is one of the well known manufacturers,
exporters and suppliers of pure essential oils, aroma oils, perfume oils and fragrance oils across
the perfumery industry as a company true to its authenticity and values with every step marked by
creativity and innovation. BMV Fragrances believes in the power of knowledge and commitment for the
satisfaction of our customers across the globe. With a combined experience of more than 87 years and
our continuous and intensive research in the field of [**natural essential oils**][42] and
[**perfumery materials**][43] has enabled us to know our client's needs better for essential oils
and constantly strive to meet their expectations.

This fusion of knowledge, affinity towards nature and creativity has made us one of the largest
producers of essential oils, resin, [**synthetic essential oil**][44], [**reconstitutions**][45] and
[**perfumery bases**][46], perfume oils. We provide [**100% pure essential oils in wholesale**][47],
including Fragrance Oils, Perfume Oils, Aromatherapy Oils, resin manufacturing, along with
Reconstitution Oils and Specialities to different industries. Our top-quality product range has made
us an approved supplier, manufacturer, and trusted brand in wholesaling of essential oils, synthetic
essential oils, fragrance oils and [**resins manufacturer**][48].

We welcome all your requirements of 100% natural, pure & natural essential oils, [**perfume
oils**][49] and [**fragrance oils**][50]. Every single day our team of researchers and innovators
set out to bring a new variety of pure and natural or reconstitutions of oils, synthetic essential
oils, [**resinoids**][51], absolutes and [**perfumery bases**][52] to the shelves to deliver to our
valued customers. We not only make sure that we improve the variety but also maintain the highest
quality of all our products which always live beyond the expectations of our clients. We have a firm
determination to deliver the best products as per our commitments to client satisfaction.

# Manufacturer of World Class 100% Pure & Natural Essential Oils, Resins, Perfume Oils and Fragrance
# Oils

Since our inception in the year 1990, the primary objective of BMV has been to passionately work
towards the creation of a nature friendly environment. BMV is one of the well known manufacturers,
exporters and suppliers of pure essential oils, aroma oils, perfume oils and fragrance oils across
the perfumery industry as a company true to its authenticity and values with every step marked by
creativity and innovation. BMV Fragrances believes in the power of knowledge and commitment for the
satisfaction of our customers across the globe. With a combined experience of more than 87 years and
our continuous and intensive research in the field of [**natural essential oils**][42] and
[**perfumery materials**][43] has enabled us to know our client's needs better for essential oils
and constantly strive to meet their expectations.

This fusion of knowledge, affinity towards nature and creativity has made us one of the largest
producers of essential oils, resin, [**synthetic essential oil**][44], [**reconstitutions**][45] and
[**perfumery bases**][46], perfume oils. We provide [**100% pure essential oils in wholesale**][47],
including Fragrance Oils, Perfume Oils, Aromatherapy Oils, resin manufacturing, along with
Reconstitution Oils and Specialities to different industries. Our top-quality product range has made
us an approved supplier, manufacturer, and trusted brand in wholesaling of essential oils, synthetic
essential oils, fragrance oils and [**resins manufacturer**][48].

We welcome all your requirements of 100% natural, pure & natural essential oils, [**perfume
oils**][49] and [**fragrance oils**][50]. Every single day our team of researchers and innovators
set out to bring a new variety of pure and natural or reconstitutions of oils, synthetic essential
oils, [**resinoids**][51], absolutes and [**perfumery bases**][52] to the shelves to deliver to our
valued customers. We not only make sure that we improve the variety but also maintain the highest
quality of all our products which always live beyond the expectations of our clients. We have a firm
determination to deliver the best products as per our commitments to client satisfaction.

### FAQ: : Aromatic Chemicals in Fragrance Creation

[ What are Aromatic Chemicals? ][178]

Aroma Chemicals are odorous chemical compounds with varying degrees of strength, stability,
tenacity. They are primary building blocks of a Fragrance and are the result of advancements in
synthetic chemistry.

[ What are Natural Aroma Chemicals? ][179]

Natural Aroma Chemicals can be called as Isolates, where in a specific molecular compound is
enriched from a natural source. Most common examples include, Geraniol ex Palmarosa Essential Oil,
Rhodinal ex Geranium etc

[ What are Synthetic Aroma Chemicals? ][180]

These are Synthetic Chemicals that manufactured in a laboratory via Chemical or Biological
processes. For example, Phenyl Ethyl Alcohol, Amyl Acetate etc.

[ Who manufactures Aroma Chemicals? ][181]

There are many manufacturers globally  such as IFF, Symrise, BASF, Solvay, DSM etc and there are
many in each region.

### FAQ: Essential Oils, Pure vs Reconstituted Essential Oils & Aromatherapy

[ What are Essential Oils? ][182]

Essential Oils are volatile oils obtained from plant materials by different methods (distillation,
solvent extraction, cold press etc)

[ What are Pure Essential Oils ][183]
* Pure Essential Oil indicates that an oil is in its purest form without any additional
  solvents/enhancing aromatic chemicals etc.
* Distillation, Solvent Extraction, Cold Press, Enfleurage are some of the methods used in the
  extraction of Natural Oils.
[ What are Reconstituted Essential Oils (RCOs) ][184]

Reconstituted Oils are recreations with synthetic aroma chemicals (found in nature). In most cases
they have a significant portion of the the natural oils too. 

[ Essential oils in Aromatherapy? ][185]
* The health effects of pure natural oils have been established via published research and through
  historical citations. The word 'Aromatherapy' means Healing through Aroma. It involves trained
  certified therapists using the right selection of pure oils for treating various health
  conditions.
* Please note that, there has been widespread misuse in labelling several products that are just
  aromachemicals or reconstituted oils as 'Aromatherapy' products.

### FAQ: : Aromatic Chemicals in Fragrance Creation

[ What are Aromatic Chemicals? ][178]

Aroma Chemicals are odorous chemical compounds with varying degrees of strength, stability,
tenacity. They are primary building blocks of a Fragrance and are the result of advancements in
synthetic chemistry.

[ What are Natural Aroma Chemicals? ][179]

Natural Aroma Chemicals can be called as Isolates, where in a specific molecular compound is
enriched from a natural source. Most common examples include, Geraniol ex Palmarosa Essential Oil,
Rhodinal ex Geranium etc

[ What are Synthetic Aroma Chemicals? ][180]

These are Synthetic Chemicals that manufactured in a laboratory via Chemical or Biological
processes. For example, Phenyl Ethyl Alcohol, Amyl Acetate etc.

[ Who manufactures Aroma Chemicals? ][181]

There are many manufacturers globally  such as IFF, Symrise, BASF, Solvay, DSM etc and there are
many in each region.

### FAQ: Essential Oils, Pure vs Reconstituted Essential Oils & Aromatherapy

[ What are Essential Oils? ][182]

Essential Oils are volatile oils obtained from plant materials by different methods (distillation,
solvent extraction, cold press etc)

[ What are Pure Essential Oils ][183]
* Pure Essential Oil indicates that an oil is in its purest form without any additional
  solvents/enhancing aromatic chemicals etc.
* Distillation, Solvent Extraction, Cold Press, Enfleurage are some of the methods used in the
  extraction of Natural Oils.
[ What are Reconstituted Essential Oils (RCOs) ][184]

Reconstituted Oils are recreations with synthetic aroma chemicals (found in nature). In most cases
they have a significant portion of the the natural oils too. 

[ Essential oils in Aromatherapy? ][185]
* The health effects of pure natural oils have been established via published research and through
  historical citations. The word 'Aromatherapy' means Healing through Aroma. It involves trained
  certified therapists using the right selection of pure oils for treating various health
  conditions.
* Please note that, there has been widespread misuse in labelling several products that are just
  aromachemicals or reconstituted oils as 'Aromatherapy' products.

constantly revealing **new ingredients, scents and flavours**. We survey landscapes, near and far,

notably cold pressed **Citrus Oils**, **Natural Isolates**, and **Canadian Forest Naturals**

flavour, pharmaceutical, aromatherapy, cosmetic, fine fragrance, personal care, household fragrance
and industrial cleaner industries.

[Apa itu Dropshipaja ?][16]

Dropshipaja adalah platform dropship & platform print on demand indonesia untuk anda melakukan

# Spikenard (Jatamansi) Oil

Discovered by the Egyptologists in Cleopatra’s perfume ointment jars, spikenard has traveled from
its origin above 8,000 feet in the Himalayas across the silk routes on camel’s backs for over
millennia. Written about in the “Song of Solomon”, Jesus had his feet anointed with Spikenard by
Mary Magdelene before the Last Supper. The oil was used by Roman perfumers and the Mughal empress
Nur Jehan in her rejuvenating cosmetics preparations. Dioscordes wrote that the herb was good for
nausea, flatulent indigestion, menstrual problems, inflammations and conjunctivitis. A pungent
rhizome root with a heavy, sweet-woody, spicy-animal odor.The herb encourages sweating making it
useful in treating fevers and since it is stimulating and detoxifying, it is commonly used to treat
the early stages of illness. Infusions and decoctions are used to treat colds and coughs and other
such respiratory conditions as asthma, as well as for rheumatism. Applied externally as a poultice,
it is used on a number of different skin conditions, including eczema.Looking like a dreadlock, this
fragrant root is known as a “yogi herb”, used by yogis for millennia for it is said it increase
awareness and is traditionally used by meditators to “ground the mind”. Valued by Ayurvedic and
Himalayan physicians for its powerful sedative properties as well as for its soothing effect on the
skin and restorative effect on the hair. It is used traditionally for complexion, strength,
spasmodic hysteria, nervous convulsions, nervous headache, epilepsy, and heart palipitations. In
Ayurveda, spikenard is traditionally used in hair preparations to not only calm the mind, but to
keep hair from falling out. Its earthy, scent is said to please the earth spirits. Commonly burned
as incense among Himalayan dwellers to calm and sanctify the environment.Jatamansi oil is obtained
by steam distillation of dried rhizomes of Nardostachys jatamansi D.C.

## Essential Oils

The world of natural aromatics and perfumery is based on essential oils – the volatile compounds
found within aromatic plants. Essential oils function as a type of immune system for plants. Humans
can benefit from the therapeutic qualities of these plants simply through inhaling the scent of the
oils – hence the term ‘aromatherapy’.

While the term ‘aromatherapy’ is relatively modern, botanical aromatics have been employed for
thousands of years. Indeed, Emperors have launched wars across continents in the hopes of
controlling the production and supply of valuable aromatics.

In a world filled with synthetics, truly artisanal aromatics are a rare find… so we invite you to
step into a world where purity and nature are the spirit, and essential oils are the heart and soul…

**The EOX offers the purest Therapeutic Grade essential oils and aromatics that are not diluted or
adulterated. Read our article on [Therapeutic Grade Essential Oils][88] for more on what this means.
**

## Essential Oils

The world of natural aromatics and perfumery is based on essential oils – the volatile compounds
found within aromatic plants. Essential oils function as a type of immune system for plants. Humans
can benefit from the therapeutic qualities of these plants simply through inhaling the scent of the
oils – hence the term ‘aromatherapy’.

While the term ‘aromatherapy’ is relatively modern, botanical aromatics have been employed for
thousands of years. Indeed, Emperors have launched wars across continents in the hopes of
controlling the production and supply of valuable aromatics.

In a world filled with synthetics, truly artisanal aromatics are a rare find… so we invite you to
step into a world where purity and nature are the spirit, and essential oils are the heart and soul…

**The EOX offers the purest Therapeutic Grade essential oils and aromatics that are not diluted or
adulterated. Read our article on [Therapeutic Grade Essential Oils][88] for more on what this means.

## Essential Oil Diffusers

[compact mini diffuser for travel][compact mini diffuser for travel]

A Mini Portable Diffuser

[Diffusing essential oils][75] enhances your environment by filling the room with the particular
fragrances of the essential oil or essential oil blend you’re using.

If you’re wondering whether it’s better to use an oil burner or an oil diffuser for aromatherapy,
note there is **a very important difference** between Ultrasonic essential oil diffusers vs. heat
diffusers.

Using a heat source, even when used indirectly onto the essential oils, **causes the oils to
evaporate very quickly and therefore may not be able to maximize the full healing and therapeutic
potential of the essential oil**. To ensure a gentle approach to diffusing essential oils, use an
ultrasonic, nebulizing, or [passive][76] type of oil diffuser.

## Everyday Favorite Essential Oils

While there are many commonly known benefits and uses of essential oils, there is also a very
individual approach to using essential oils in your everyday life and you will definitely find your
own favorite scents and uses. 

Here’s some oils I love:
* **Lavender** – The calming, flowery scent is amazing to help you relax or go to sleep. Use it in
  aromatherapy baths, or put on a diffuser with lavender essential oil scent as you go to sleep.
  Read more on the [Top 10 Lavender Essential Oil Benefits][77].
* **Peppermint** – So good for a variety of stomach problems including nausea or morning sickness.
  Use peppermint essential oil as an after-dinner treat!
* **Frankincense** – Amazing for anything related to skin care. Use Frankincense essential oil in
  your unscented lotions, soaps, shower gels or moisturizers! Learn more in this article here
  on [the uses and benefits of Frankincense][78] essential oil.
* **Lemongrass** –  This oil is a powerhouse for anything cleansing or disinfecting. I love this
  fresh scent and use it regularly in my diffuser to get rid of household odors or pet smells. Here
  are [13 fun ways to use Lemongrass oil][79].
* **Lemon –  **Similar to Lemongrass, [Lemon essential oil uses][80] are bountiful! Use for
  cleaning or the flu, but before you put it in your diffuser please read these [citrus oil
  precautions here][81].

More essential oil favorites are added all the time. Check my [essential oils guide][82] for an
updated list!

## Using Essential Oils for Everyday Ailments

Essential oils can be a powerful addition to your home medicine cabinet. Different oils will do
different things, and even for different people. Using essential oils is an individual experience,
as much as our bodies are all individual, too. While some oils share general properties and
functions, you might have to try out two or three different types of oil until you find the one that
is YOUR match.

## Essential Oil Diffusers

[compact mini diffuser for travel][compact mini diffuser for travel]

A Mini Portable Diffuser

[Diffusing essential oils][75] enhances your environment by filling the room with the particular
fragrances of the essential oil or essential oil blend you’re using.

If you’re wondering whether it’s better to use an oil burner or an oil diffuser for aromatherapy,
note there is **a very important difference** between Ultrasonic essential oil diffusers vs. heat
diffusers.

Using a heat source, even when used indirectly onto the essential oils, **causes the oils to
evaporate very quickly and therefore may not be able to maximize the full healing and therapeutic
potential of the essential oil**. To ensure a gentle approach to diffusing essential oils, use an
ultrasonic, nebulizing, or [passive][76] type of oil diffuser.

## Everyday Favorite Essential Oils

While there are many commonly known benefits and uses of essential oils, there is also a very
individual approach to using essential oils in your everyday life and you will definitely find your
own favorite scents and uses. 

Here’s some oils I love:
* **Lavender** – The calming, flowery scent is amazing to help you relax or go to sleep. Use it in
  aromatherapy baths, or put on a diffuser with lavender essential oil scent as you go to sleep.
  Read more on the [Top 10 Lavender Essential Oil Benefits][77].
* **Peppermint** – So good for a variety of stomach problems including nausea or morning sickness.
  Use peppermint essential oil as an after-dinner treat!
* **Frankincense** – Amazing for anything related to skin care. Use Frankincense essential oil in
  your unscented lotions, soaps, shower gels or moisturizers! Learn more in this article here
  on [the uses and benefits of Frankincense][78] essential oil.
* **Lemongrass** –  This oil is a powerhouse for anything cleansing or disinfecting. I love this
  fresh scent and use it regularly in my diffuser to get rid of household odors or pet smells. Here
  are [13 fun ways to use Lemongrass oil][79].
* **Lemon –  **Similar to Lemongrass, [Lemon essential oil uses][80] are bountiful! Use for
  cleaning or the flu, but before you put it in your diffuser please read these [citrus oil
  precautions here][81].

More essential oil favorites are added all the time. Check my [essential oils guide][82] for an
updated list!

## Using Essential Oils for Everyday Ailments

Essential oils can be a powerful addition to your home medicine cabinet. Different oils will do
different things, and even for different people. Using essential oils is an individual experience,
as much as our bodies are all individual, too. While some oils share general properties and
functions, you might have to try out two or three different types of oil until you find the one that
is YOUR match.

## Essential OIl Resource Consultants

## providers of information, education & research in the field of essential oils

# Welcome to Essential Oil Resource Consultants

**Essential Oil Resource Consultants (EORC) are providers of research, education and information
in the field of essential oils and aromatherapy.**

With experience spanning more than three decades, EORC promotes excellence in safe and effective
essential oil use as well as striving to provide up-to-date and relevant information to all users of
essential oils.

Their expertise in clinical aromatherapy and the integration of essential oils in healthcare
settings around the world is a particular focus.

Via the International Clinical Aromatherapy Network, EORC also acts as a connecting hub for
professional aromatherapists worldwide irrespective of their affiliations to aromatherapy
organisations or schools, thereby promoting and facilitating connections, collaborations and the
evolution of professional aromatherapy around the world.

EORC is a registered company based in France and headed by [**Rhiannon Lewis**][22].

Based in the mountains of Provence, France, EORC’s reach and ongoing impact is truly international,
connecting users of essential oils around the world.

EORC accomplishes its mission of providing research, education and information in five main ways:

**Education**

**Conference Events**

**Publishing**

**Networking**

**Consultancy**

 

## Education

Through a range of online and in-person programs, Rhiannon offers a palette of evidence-based
learning opportunities as well as providing customised classes for private or public institutions…

[ Learn More ][23]

## Conferences

Through her work and extensive travels, Rhiannon has developed an extensive network of professional
connections in the scientific and aromatherapy worlds. Bringing these actors together to share their
research and passion was a natural step…

[ Learn More ][24]

## Publishing

Sharing information related to the ever-increasing evidence based for aromatherapy integration is an
essential part of EORC’s mission…

 

[ Learn More ][25]

## Networking

EORC is convinced that networking and information sharing is an essential part of healthy
aromatherapy integration.
In 2021, EORC created the International Clinical Aromatherapy Network (ICAN), the only independent
online network for all aromatherapy professionals…

[ Learn More ][26]

## Consultancy

EORC is available for consultancy on projects related to aromatherapy provision including guidance
for formulations, curriculum development, essential oil chemistry, specialist topic deep dives and
evidence gathering.

 

[ Learn More ][27]

**Do you want to keep up with EORC News and happenings?**

By opting to receive EORC News, you will receive a periodical newsletter with community insights,
latest happenings and educational snippets about aromatherapy from Rhiannon.

It will also help you to keep your finger on the pulse of any upcoming EORC-related classes and
events.

But don’t worry, your subscription won’t result in an overflowing mailbox with heavy marketing !

We appreciate your support and have a vision to keep moving aromatherapy forward.

**Essential Oil Resource Consultants (EORC) are providers of research, education and information
in the field of essential oils and aromatherapy.**

With experience spanning more than three decades, EORC promotes excellence in safe and effective
essential oil use as well as striving to provide up-to-date and relevant information to all users of
essential oils.

Their expertise in clinical aromatherapy and the integration of essential oils in healthcare
settings around the world is a particular focus.

Via the International Clinical Aromatherapy Network, EORC also acts as a connecting hub for
professional aromatherapists worldwide irrespective of their affiliations to aromatherapy
organisations or schools, thereby promoting and facilitating connections, collaborations and the
evolution of professional aromatherapy around the world.

EORC is a registered company based in France and headed by [**Rhiannon Lewis**][22].

Based in the mountains of Provence, France, EORC’s reach and ongoing impact is truly international,
connecting users of essential oils around the world.

EORC accomplishes its mission of providing research, education and information in five main ways:

**Education**

**Conference Events**

**Publishing**

**Networking**

**Consultancy**

 

## Education

Through a range of online and in-person programs, Rhiannon offers a palette of evidence-based
learning opportunities as well as providing customised classes for private or public institutions…

[ Learn More ][23]

## Conferences

Through her work and extensive travels, Rhiannon has developed an extensive network of professional
connections in the scientific and aromatherapy worlds. Bringing these actors together to share their
research and passion was a natural step…

[ Learn More ][24]

## Publishing

Sharing information related to the ever-increasing evidence based for aromatherapy integration is an
essential part of EORC’s mission…

 

[ Learn More ][25]

## Networking

EORC is convinced that networking and information sharing is an essential part of healthy
aromatherapy integration.
In 2021, EORC created the International Clinical Aromatherapy Network (ICAN), the only independent
online network for all aromatherapy professionals…

[ Learn More ][26]

## Consultancy

EORC is available for consultancy on projects related to aromatherapy provision including guidance
for formulations, curriculum development, essential oil chemistry, specialist topic deep dives and
evidence gathering.

 

[ Learn More ][27]

**Do you want to keep up with EORC News and happenings?**

By opting to receive EORC News, you will receive a periodical newsletter with community insights,
latest happenings and educational snippets about aromatherapy from Rhiannon.

It will also help you to keep your finger on the pulse of any upcoming EORC-related classes and
events.

But don’t worry, your subscription won’t result in an overflowing mailbox with heavy marketing !

We appreciate your support and have a vision to keep moving aromatherapy forward.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Does HBNO have minimum order quantities for bulk products?

No. HBNO offers flexible ordering with no minimum order quantity, allowing buyers to scale
purchasing based on current production needs. We recommend providing a forecast of your needs for
proactive planning.

### Can HBNO support private label and contract manufacturing?

Yes. HBNO provides private label and contract manufacturing services across categories, including
oils, formulations, and natural raw materials.

### Does HBNO provide regulatory documentation for all products?

Yes. Each shipment includes a Certificate of Analysis, Safety Data Sheet, and supporting compliance
documentation to meet regulatory and quality assurance standards.

Discover the top coolest headquarters and corporate offices in the world—iconic workplaces known for
innovative design, creative architecture, and inspiring office environments. These world-class
company headquarters set new standards for modern corporate office culture, blending functionality
with bold aesthetics to create spaces that employees genuinely enjoy working in every day.

From cutting-edge technology campuses to architecturally stunning corporate offices, these
headquarters showcase how thoughtful design, open collaboration spaces, and employee-focused
amenities can transform the workplace experience. Each headquarters highlights unique approaches to
office layout, sustainability, wellness, and creativity, making them a powerful source of
inspiration for corporate office management teams and business leaders worldwide.

To explore these incredible headquarters in action and see what makes them stand out, watch the

If you have ever wondered what it would be like to work in a truly inspiring corporate environment,
these headquarters represent the ultimate vision of modern office life. They are not just
offices—they are destinations that reflect company culture, innovation, and forward-thinking
leadership, and they continue to influence how organizations design and manage their headquarters

## **What can you find in a company headquarters?**

In a company headquarters, you will typically find the organization’s leadership team along with its
most critical business functions. These departments and offices work together to manage strategy,
operations, and long-term growth:
* **Chief Executive Officer (CEO) Office** – Responsible for overall vision, leadership, and
  strategic decision-making.
* **Executive Team & Board of Directors** – Oversees corporate governance, policy direction, and
  high-level business objectives.
* **Administration Office** – Handles internal coordination, office management, and organizational
  support functions.
* **Finance, Accounting & Billing Department** – Manages budgets, financial reporting, payroll,
  billing, and compliance.
* **Marketing & Communications Department** – Develops branding, public relations, advertising, and
  internal and external communications.
* **Sales Department** – Drives revenue generation, client acquisition, and business development
  efforts.
* **Customer Service & Support** – Provides assistance to customers, manages inquiries, and resolves
  issues.
* **Research & Development Department** – Focuses on innovation, product development, and improving
  existing services or technologies.
* **Operations & Logistics** – Oversees daily business operations, supply chains, and operational
  efficiency.
* **Human Resources Department** – Manages recruitment, employee relations, benefits, training, and
  workplace policies.
* **Legal Department** – Handles contracts, regulatory compliance, risk management, and legal
  matters affecting the company.

Together, these offices form the operational and strategic core of a company, making the
headquarters the central hub for leadership, planning, and decision-making.

## **Top Coolest Headquarters in the World**

Discover the top coolest headquarters and corporate offices in the world—iconic workplaces known for
innovative design, creative architecture, and inspiring office environments. These world-class
company headquarters set new standards for modern corporate office culture, blending functionality
with bold aesthetics to create spaces that employees genuinely enjoy working in every day.

From cutting-edge technology campuses to architecturally stunning corporate offices, these
headquarters showcase how thoughtful design, open collaboration spaces, and employee-focused
amenities can transform the workplace experience. Each headquarters highlights unique approaches to
office layout, sustainability, wellness, and creativity, making them a powerful source of
inspiration for corporate office management teams and business leaders worldwide.

To explore these incredible headquarters in action and see what makes them stand out, watch the
video below for a visual tour of some of the coolest corporate offices in the world:

If you have ever wondered what it would be like to work in a truly inspiring corporate environment,
these headquarters represent the ultimate vision of modern office life. They are not just
offices—they are destinations that reflect company culture, innovation, and forward-thinking
leadership, and they continue to influence how organizations design and manage their headquarters
across the globe.

## **What can you find in a company headquarters?**

In a company headquarters, you will typically find the organization’s leadership team along with its
most critical business functions. These departments and offices work together to manage strategy,
operations, and long-term growth:
* **Chief Executive Officer (CEO) Office** – Responsible for overall vision, leadership, and
  strategic decision-making.
* **Executive Team & Board of Directors** – Oversees corporate governance, policy direction, and
  high-level business objectives.
* **Administration Office** – Handles internal coordination, office management, and organizational
  support functions.
* **Finance, Accounting & Billing Department** – Manages budgets, financial reporting, payroll,
  billing, and compliance.
* **Marketing & Communications Department** – Develops branding, public relations, advertising, and
  internal and external communications.
* **Sales Department** – Drives revenue generation, client acquisition, and business development
  efforts.
* **Customer Service & Support** – Provides assistance to customers, manages inquiries, and resolves
  issues.
* **Research & Development Department** – Focuses on innovation, product development, and improving
  existing services or technologies.
* **Operations & Logistics** – Oversees daily business operations, supply chains, and operational
  efficiency.
* **Human Resources Department** – Manages recruitment, employee relations, benefits, training, and
  workplace policies.
* **Legal Department** – Handles contracts, regulatory compliance, risk management, and legal
  matters affecting the company.

Together, these offices form the operational and strategic core of a company, making the
headquarters the central hub for leadership, planning, and decision-making.

## Healing Fragrances Aromatherapy School

Founded in 2002 by Danielle Sade, our mission is to provide the latest education on aromatherapy and
essential oils. Our students will gain a deep understanding of essential oils and an unbiased
education that eliminates misinformation. Our courses can be taken at your own pace, from anywhere
in the world. You will have unlimited access to the learning platform and one-on-one support. 

Upon graduating, you will have the knowledge to succeed at each stage of your aromatherapy journey.
Our graduates have used their knowledge and skills as a solitary vocation in clinical care, skincare
cosmetics, formulators, or have effectively integrated aromatherapy into their careers. Once you
have graduated you will become a Certified Aromatherapy Health Professional (CAHP), recognized by
the Canadian Federation of Aromatherapist. Whether you are looking to invest in your interests or
enhance your career, our courses are designed to take your knowledge to the next level.

## Immortelle Therapy

The World’s Finest Helichrysum Italicum!
* [ABOUT US][17]
* [OUR PLANTATION][18]
* [OUR DISTELLERY][19]
* [CERTIFICATION][20]

As a second generation, family owned company, our legacy of providing quality, and unrivaled
service, has sustained Immortelle Therapy’s position as the leading manufacturer of Helichrysum
italicum, Lavender and Sage essential oils and herbs in Balkan. We are an Albanian – American
company that grows and distill the finest essential oils and hydrosol (floral waters) in the region.
Our global headquarters (Sales Office) is based in NYC. We produce 100% organic & pure and natural
raw materials for professionals working in personal care, cosmetic, perfumery, pharmaceutical and
aromatherapy and food industry. Helichrysum italicum, Lavender and Sage plants from Albania produce
high quality essential oils / herbs. Due to the Mediterranean climate, soil composition, and long
dry summers brew the perfect conditions for this plant to grow and blossom. As a result it produces
Helichicrysum italicum, Lavender and Sage essential oils, which is well-balanced in all key
ingredients.

The Immortelle, Lavender and Sage that we grow is the Helichrysum italicum, Lavandula angustifolia
and Salvia Officinalis species that is native to the Mediterranean region. We source our seeds from
natural occurring Immortelle and Sage that is found in the wild in Albania, which is known to
produce the highest quality helichrysum italicum, Lavender and Sage essential oils and herbs. The
plantations are surrounded with untouched nature, mountains, grasslands and meadows, without
influence from agricultural mono-cultures or other pollutants. Our plantations are supervised by
experts. The Helichrysum Italicum, Lavender and Sage plants are hand-planted and 100% organically
grown without any use of pesticides, fertilizers, fungicides, watering or any stimulatory
supplements. Great geo-location, Mediterranean climate, karst terrain and driven dedication to work
are guarantees of quality for our products.

The extraction method we use is steam distillation. This method complies with all environmental
standards with respect to the original state of the plant. Employing modern technology in
distillation ensures the highest quality oil extract while preserving all of the fragile chemical
constituents of the plant. We produce our essential oils products according to the highest standard
of quality, purity, and safety used in the industry. From harvested wild seeds, to cultivating the
Helichrsysum italicum, Lavender and Sage plants and the distillation practice we are part of the
whole production process. Thought dedication and unique craftsmanship of our staff, we pledges to
produce 100% organic and pure Helichrysum italicum , Lavender and Sage essential oils and Herbs.

color/full bloom.

## Meet our Team

[Our Team][49] strive to create a unique, engaging work environment that fosters the kind of loyalty
and long-term commitment that makes for consistently happy employees and customers.

## Harvest Season

When comes harvest season on our farms all is done by hand. This does not cause unnecessary
pollution of plants due to machine exhaust. We do not fertilize lands, water plants or anything
else.

## Production of essential oil

Helichrysum oils are a fairly expensive oil to produce, as one ton of hand-harvested flowering tops
distills into only 1 kg (2.2 lbs.) of essential oil and 75 liters (20 gallons) of hydrosol.

## GC/MS Analysis

After distillation samples are taken and sent for [GC/MS analysis][50]. Two independent third party
testing laboratories in [U.S.][51] and [Canada][52] are offering an unbiased analytical testings for
our Helichrysum oil & Hydrosol

Our Helichrysum Italicum essential oil is produced and crafted with the intention of being used
medicinally for its healing properties. Distilling is not just a job, it’s an art!

with water separating. Helichrysum can be grown from seeds and from cuttings of plants.

**Offering world, **the finest floral concentrates and natural absolutes

Katyani Exports is a well established group engaged in manufacturing Natural Essential Oils, Spice
Oils, Carrier Oils, Mint Oils and Floral Absolutes on a large scale. The company has two
manufacturing units one is near orcha district in Madhya Pradesh for distillation of Essential Oils
like Cypriol, Ajowain Oil, Cumin Oil, Dill Seed Oil, Carrot Seed Oil, Juniper Berry Oil, Sugandh
Mantri Oil, Valerian Root Oil, etc. and other unit is in Mandsaur (Madhya Pradesh) for manufacturing
of Herbal Extracts and Oleoresins.

Oils, Carrier Oils, Mint Oils and Floral Absolutes on a large scale. The company has two

Mantri Oil, Valerian Root Oil, etc. and other unit is in Mandsaur (Madhya Pradesh) for manufacturing

The Problem

## Procurement doesn't capture the value already sitting in it's existing portfolio...

01 — The reality
Data scattered across multiple systems

Spreadsheets on shared drives. Records in SAP, Oracle, Coupa. Contacts in Outlook. The same supplier
exists three times under three names.

02 — The consequence
No transparency on what you have

You can’t search what you can’t see. Capabilities and risk signals exist in fragments — never as one
queryable picture of your portfolio.

03 — The blind spot
Hidden potential in portfolio and markets

You source new suppliers for capabilities you already have. Existing partners are passed over
because nobody knows what they can do.

04 — The cost
Missed opportunities and market changes

Every new initiative starts from a partial view. Decisions miss the alternatives you never knew
existed.

## Upload spreadsheet.
## Searchable in 10 minutes.

sitting in your portfolio. 
Procurement teams work with Matchory on a single data layer, all grounded in verified supplier
information.

required.

you had.

## Elevate Your Journey

[Picture]
Provisions for Summiting Your Peak

## GAIA

## Earth Goddess

*The ancestral mother of all life, bearer of mountains and rivers; sky and sea,
Gaia represents the synergistic systems of energy rooted in organic grace.*
From a small fishing community in Alaska, to the rugged peaks of Colorado I now call home, my life
journey has been defined by subsistence, persistence, adventure, and connections. The ebb and flow
of my interactions with diversely beautiful environments and associated people have navigated my
course to live receptively with intention and gratitude. 

As a mother, my greatest hope for my children is that they will be the balance of both my influence
as supporter, teacher, and lover of the natural world, and their internal compass; that they will be
grounded by humility, yet take risks to rise and shine beyond the restricting world of boxes in
which we live.

**Mountain Gaia** exists as a resource along what can feel like a twisted trail of chaos to a
nourishing path rooted with resources to support your active lifestyle. We'll share tips and tricks
for adventuring outdoors, inspiration for getting out the door in the first place, as well as
anecdotal education for proactive health along the way. Embrace your journey!

Elevate Life!
[Picture]




**

Annie Thompson,* A Mountain Mama*
“The love of wilderness is more than a hunger for what is always beyond reach; it is also an
expression of loyalty to the earth, the earth which bore us and sustains us, the only paradise we
shall ever know, the only paradise we ever need...” 
~*Edward Abbey*

My work bridges traditional wisdom and modern science, helping you understand how ingredients,
habits, and daily choices affect the body, the skin, and overall wellbeing.

Everything here is grounded, thoughtful, and designed to support informed, sustainable choices, not

commercial products that just didn’t feel right for me.
Over time I realised that **nature already provides everything we need** for healthy, glowing skin.
So I started learning, experimenting, and eventually became a **certified organic skincare
formulator and health coach**. Now I’m sharing what I’m learning with all of you.

I created this space for people who are **curious about natural health and care but don’t know where
to start**. It’s for those who want **simple, effective, plant-based solutions** without the
overwhelm.
I’ve spent years researching and formulating skincare, and I know how hard it is to find **reliable,
no-fluff information**. So, I built this site to be:
**Practical**, honest, accessible.
This isn’t just another health and natural beauty blog (hopefully) but a space you can trust, learn
from and experiment.

sometimes you might need information in a particular way. I try to cater for everyone, from the
beginner to the seasoned enthusiast. I really hope you learn and follow and enjoy and grow!

#### **My Journey**

I’ve always been passionate about **natural health and beauty**. But like many, I started out
feeling lost and very confused by all the skincare advice out there as well as frustrated with
commercial products that just didn’t feel right for me.
Over time I realised that **nature already provides everything we need** for healthy, glowing skin.
So I started learning, experimenting, and eventually became a **certified organic skincare
formulator and health coach**. Now I’m sharing what I’m learning with all of you.

#### Why this Site

I created this space for people who are **curious about natural health and care but don’t know where
to start**. It’s for those who want **simple, effective, plant-based solutions** without the
overwhelm.
I’ve spent years researching and formulating skincare, and I know how hard it is to find **reliable,
no-fluff information**. So, I built this site to be:
**Practical**, honest, accessible.
This isn’t just another health and natural beauty blog (hopefully) but a space you can trust, learn
from and experiment.

#### Expect a lot!

Here’s what you’ll find: DIY skincare recipes, ingredient guides, skincare tips, natural beauty and
wellness articles, essential oils, aromatherapy, herbal remedies and more!
My articles are hopefully easy to digest and also easy to follow. I try my best but I understand
sometimes you might need information in a particular way. I try to cater for everyone, from the
beginner to the seasoned enthusiast. I really hope you learn and follow and enjoy and grow!

### Why Rocky Mountain Oils

[SAFE Promise]

#### SAFE Promise

Our S.A.A.F.E Promise is our guarantee to you that **[our essential oils][126]** are what we say
they are: 100% pure, natural, and authentic. To verify the purity and quality of our oils, we
provide you with the independent lab **[GC/MS test][127]** results for each oil. We are passionate
about providing you and your family with safe and effective natural resources to revitalize your
health.

[Satisfaction Guarantee]

#### Satisfaction Guarantee

We are committed to providing you with 100% natural and pure essential oils and natural products
that work for your health and wellness needs. Shop risk-free and discover the healing powers of
nature with our **[90-Day Satisfaction Guarantee][128]** and free return.

[Rocky Mountain Vision]

#### Rocky Mountain Vision

From the air you breathe to the oils you use, the Earth provides a whole pharmacy full of natural
remedies essential to your wellbeing. Experience the healing powers of nature with essential oils
that are **[sustainably][129]** sourced and 100% pure and authentic, just as Mother Nature intended.

[Our Commitment To Quality]

#### Our Commitment To Quality

Our commitment to quality starts right from the beginning. All of our oils are sourced from farms
around the globe that practice sustainable farming methods to ensure the quality and efficacy of the
oil. Each oil is rigorously and independently tested before it reaches your hands.

# Welcome to A New Hope Educational Services!


Back in 2007, we were living in Flint, Michigan, cleaning toilets (literally), raising four kids,
and trying to stretch $11,000 a year into enough for a family of six. Spoiler: it didn’t stretch. We
were sick, tired, broke, out of shape, and desperate for something better. Then a friend handed us a
bottle of essential oils. Honestly? I rolled my eyes. But that little bottle cracked the door wide
open and gave us what we now call A New Hope Educational Services.


What started as “eh, we’ll see if this works” turned into a full-blown lifestyle shift. Now, almost
two decades later, we’ve had the privilege of walking alongside thousands of people as they step
into wellness, purpose, and abundance. And if I have anything to say about it, you’ll be next.

##  

## Our Mission

Here’s the truth → your past doesn’t get to boss your future around. Not your health history, not
your empty bank account, not that voice in your head that says you’re too far gone. Nope. You were
created to live a vibrant, extraordinary life. And if you hang around here long enough, I’m going to
make sure you start believing that too.


This space is about real talk, belly laughs, nerdy science, and practical tools that actually work.
If you want fluffy fairy dust, you’re in the wrong place. But if you want straight-up wisdom mixed
with sass and soul, pull up a chair.


## What You’ll Find Here

## (a.k.a. All the Things I’m Passionate About)

People keep telling me, “Shannon, you’ve got to narrow it down. Pick ONE passion so you draw the
right people.”


Ummm… nope. Not happening. I’m passionate about a lot of things, and I pray that list keeps growing.
That’s who I am. That’s how I teach. And honestly? That’s what makes life fun.

### Breast Health 

This one’s personal. My mom passed away from breast cancer, and because of that, I am passionate
about teaching you how to support your beautiful breasts. Prevention, awareness, lifestyle choices,
natural tools, I want women (and men, because yes, men have breast tissue too) to feel empowered,
educated, and proactive about protecting this part of their health.


### Hormones

Hormones run the whole show, whether you like it or not. They can make you feel amazing or turn life
into a circus where the monkeys are running wild. I am passionate about helping both men and women
understand their hormones in plain, simple language. I’ll teach you how to balance them, support
them, and stop letting those little chemical messengers call all the shots. From perimenopause to
testosterone dips, thyroid struggles to adrenal fatigue, we break down the science and offer simple,
sustainable tools that help you feel like yourself again.


### Helping Mommas

I am insanely passionate as a doula about helping mommas, from getting pregnant, to staying
pregnant, to raising healthy, strong children. And here’s the kicker: I don’t want you just to
survive motherhood, I want you to feel amazing while you do it. Birth, postpartum, motherhood, these
are sacred seasons, and my heart beats to make sure women walk through them with confidence,
support, and joy.


### Igniting Marriages

Oh my goodness, this lights me up. There are simply not enough people teaching on relationships.
Brian and I have been happily married since 1988, he is my spark, my best friend, my partner in
everything. And let me tell you, marriage is worth tending. I am passionate about helping couples
reignite connection, rebuild intimacy, and remember why they fell in love in the first place.
Because sometimes that flame flickers, but it doesn’t have to go out.


### Food First

Like for real, this might be the most important thing I teach: Food First. It’s not just a catchy
phrase, it’s the foundation of health. Whole, simple, real food fuels every single cell in your
body. I am passionate about showing you how nutrition can heal, energize, and stabilize, without
overcomplicating your life or robbing you of joy at the table. Food doesn’t have to be complicated,
boring, or full of restrictions. Here you’ll find recipes that are wholesome, flavorful, and
family-approved, everything from quick weeknight dinners to nourishing snacks.

everything. And let me tell you, marriage is worth tending. I am passionate about helping couples
reignite connection, rebuild intimacy, and remember why they fell in love in the first place.
Because sometimes that flame flickers, but it doesn’t have to go out.


### Food First

Like for real, this might be the most important thing I teach: Food First. It’s not just a catchy
phrase, it’s the foundation of health. Whole, simple, real food fuels every single cell in your
body. I am passionate about showing you how nutrition can heal, energize, and stabilize, without
overcomplicating your life or robbing you of joy at the table. Food doesn’t have to be complicated,
boring, or full of restrictions. Here you’ll find recipes that are wholesome, flavorful, and
family-approved, everything from quick weeknight dinners to nourishing snacks.


### Essential Oils

These tiny little plant molecules blow my mind, teeny, tiny, and yet able to touch every cell in
your body. I am passionate about teaching how to use oils in everyday life, to shift your mood,
clean your home, support your health, and literally change the environment around you. We’ve used
oils and plant-based remedies in our own family for nearly two decades, and I love teaching others
how to make them part of their everyday rhythm.


### Supplements

Supplements are often the missing puzzle piece in the “why do I feel so off?” question. I am
passionate about filling in those gaps, from ionic minerals, to magnesium, to Vitamin D (that
powerhouse “pro-hormone” that touches nearly every other hormone in your body). Supplements aren’t a
magic pill, but they can be the game-changer your body’s been begging for.


### Movement and Exercise

This is my current tiptoeing passion, and honestly, it feels like a miracle. After being in a
wheelchair with MS and hooked up to full-time oxygen, my body had completely atrophied. I’m now in
the process of rebuilding it, one tiny step (and one sweaty minute) at a time.


I’m passionate about this because I know what it feels like to have your body betray you. I also
know the joy of giving it a second chance. These days, I get up for 5 minutes every hour and do
small movements, weights, calisthenics, stretches, and I can now walk for 15 minutes after meals.
That might not sound like much to some people, but for me it’s victory.


My goal: to walk the Bobby Crim Road Race next August. This isn’t just about exercise, it’s about
reclaiming life, rebuilding strength, and proving to myself (and anyone watching) that it’s never
too late to start again.


### My Littles (a.k.a. Being Gigi)

Now, let’s talk about one of my favorite passions of all: my kids and grandbabies. As a
homeschooling mom turned homeschooling Gigi, these littles have kept me going when life felt too
hard and I was ready to throw in the towel. I am passionate about raising healthy, independent
children who know how and where to find truth. Teaching them how to learn is such a gift.


Even now, I still co-teach in a few homeschool groups, and our three grandbabies are being
homeschooled by their mom and dad. You bet your bippie Brian and I step in to teach and love on
them. Right now, we’re working through a unit study I created on anatomy, and we sneak in math
lessons while cooking and baking (because yes, fractions make way more sense when you’re dividing
cookie dough).


I’m passionate about life skills, the ones we sometimes forget to pass on, like budgeting, cooking,
and simply being curious. These little people are my joy, and teaching them isn’t just a duty, it’s
who we are.


### Father God

And finally, if I had to pick just one passion, this would be it. Sharing my faith, walking with
Jesus, and pointing people back to the One who gives us hope, healing, and purpose. My story makes
no sense without Him. Everything else, hormones, oils, food, health, it all flows out of the
foundation of faith. I am passionate about helping people know that they were created on purpose,
for a purpose, by a God who loves them fiercely.


So, yeah… people tell me to narrow it down, but I can’t. I can only share from where I am and what
sets my heart on fire. My prayer is that as you read, listen, or hang out here, you’ll feel that
fire spark something in you too. Because this isn’t just about my passions, it’s about helping YOU
grow yours.


## Who We Are

We’re Brian and Shannon Hudson, married since 1988, parents of four, grandparents of three, and
proof that miracles happen when you mix faith, grit, and a good sense of humor. We’ve lived through
the broke years, the sick years, and the messy years, and we came out stronger, sassier, and on a
mission.


These days, we travel, teach, write, and share what we’ve learned with people all over the world.
Whether it’s from a stage in front of thousands or here on this site, our heart is the same: to
remind you that you were created for more, and to give you tools to actually get there.


## Join the Community

You don’t have to do this alone. We’d love to have you in our [A New Hope Support Group][22], a free
Facebook community where you’ll find:
* Daily posts and encouragement
* Thousands of fellow families on a health journey
* Monthly challenges to keep you growing
* Conversations on all the passions you see here, hormones, food, oils, supplements, marriage,
  faith, and more

Request to be added, then click the box to get updates so you never miss a thing:
👉 [Join the A New Hope Support Group][23]


## Welcome to the Journey

This site is stuffed with resources: hormone help, recipes, doula wisdom, natural living hacks,
mindset shifts, and stories that’ll make you laugh, cry, and probably say, “Oh my word, that’s me.”

Take your time and look around. Watch the videos. Try the recipes. Download the resources. And if
you ever feel like you need some one-on-one conversation, an ear to listen, a friend to bounce ideas
off of, someone who’s been where you are, you can grab a time slot with me here:
👉 [Book a One-on-One Zoom Consult][24]

I’m not a doctor, nutritionist, or any kind of specialist. I’m just a momma, a Gigi, a spouse, and a
friend. But I promise to show up, listen, and share what I’ve learned from my own hard-won
experiences.


## A Quick Note Before You Dive In

Let’s get this out there, nice and clear: I’m an affiliate for multiple companies and products. That
means if I recommend something here, whether it’s a book, blender, supplement, or a gadget that
makes life easier and you decide to grab it through one of my links, I may earn a commission.


I don’t share junk. Ever. If it shows up on this site or in a post, it’s because I actually use it,
love it, and believe it could bless your life too. Period.


So yes, I get paid when you shop my links. But here’s why I love this: it allows me to pour my time,
energy, and passion into creating content, sharing resources, and showing up for you without
charging for every ounce of information. You get vetted, real-life recommendations (with a side of
sass), and I get to keep doing what I love, helping people just like you step into wellness,
purpose, and abundance. Win-win.
